body:
Vermont Pension Investment Commission, Montpelier, approved a commitment of $50 million to **Audax Private Equity** Fund VIII for the $8.2 billion Vermont Retirement Systems at its Oct. 27 meeting, VPIC deputy CIO Katie Green said in an email.

p: 몬트필리어(Montpelier)에 본부를 둔 Vermont Pension Investment Commission은 10월 27일 회의에서 82억 달러 규모의 Vermont Retirement Systems를 위해 **Audax Private Equity** Fund VIII에 5,000만 달러를 투자하기로 약정했다고 VPIC의 Katie Green 부CIO가 이메일로 밝혔다.
